detailed_descriptions.en: World War Z is a heart-pounding co-op third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring swarms of hundreds of zombies that has now captivated over 25 million players. Based on the Paramount Pictures film, World War Z focuses on fast-paced gameplay while exploring new storylines from around the world. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. From New York to Moscow to Japan and Jerusalem, the undead apocalypse continues to spread. As the end looms, a hardened few band together to defeat the horde and outlive the dead. Battle swarms of hundreds of zombies The Swarm Engine™ seamlessly renders hordes of zombies in incredible firefights. Advanced gore systems offer gruesomely satisfying action. In-game Zombie Hordes behave like real crowds, getting stuck in narrow corridors and climbing on top of each other to reach players on higher levels. Hordes become increasingly more difficult to defeat and behave like single entity bosses as players progress through the game. Coop story-driven campaigns Survive around the world, as unique groups tell their stories of perseverance. Choose Your Class Level up to 8 unique classes – Gunslinger, Hellraiser, Slasher, Medic, Fixer, Exterminator, Dronemaster and the new Vanguard class in WWZ: Aftermath – each with their own unique perks and play styles. Deep Progression Grow stronger – unlock powerful weapon upgrades and level your character class to take on greater challenges. PVPVZ Fight other players for survival – several intense Player vs Player vs Zombies game modes complement the coop campaigns.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《末日之戰》是一款令人心跳加速的第三人稱合作射擊遊戲，最多可支援4名玩家共同遊玩。遊戲中屍群數以百計，吸引的玩家已達2500萬之眾。《末日之戰》的靈感源自派拉蒙影業公司出品的影片，遊戲特色是快節奏的玩法，以及探索世界各地的全新故事情節。 人類瀕臨滅絕，從紐約、莫斯科、日本到耶路撒冷，不死的天災不斷蔓延。末日臨近之際，少數堅強的人們團結起來，擊敗屍潮，對抗死亡。 - 與成百上千的僵屍群作戰 Swarm Engine™可在激烈的槍戰中順暢渲染成群的僵屍，透過先進的斷肢系統呈現極具衝擊力的血腥動作。遊戲內的屍潮行動與真實人群無異，它們會擠在狹窄的走廊，互相攀爬，試圖接近位於高處的玩家。隨著遊戲的推進，屍群會越來越難以擊敗，並且會像單體Boss一樣行動。 - 故事驅動的合作戰役 在世界各地努力生存，瞭解獨特人物各自奮戰的故事。 - 選擇職業 升級8個專屬職業：槍手、叛逆者、劈砍者、醫療兵、修理師、殲滅者、無人機大師以及《末日之戰：劫後餘生》中新增的先鋒，每個職業都有自己獨特技能和遊戲玩法。 - 深度進階 不斷成長，解鎖強大的武器升級，提升角色職業，迎接更大的挑戰。 - PVPVZ 為了生存與其他玩家戰鬥：合作模式中新增了數種緊張刺激的玩家 vs 玩家 vs 僵屍遊戲模式。
